data.body: GHA_WAIVER: This story requires post-merge human action to configure an external heartbeat monitor. The agent cannot access arbitrary external monitoring services. Closing with waiver — operator must: (1) choose a heartbeat service (status badge, scheduled-canary GHA, or similar), (2) configure it to monitor reconcile-bridge.yml, (3) verify a simulated disable triggers an alert within the configured window, and (4) document the service name and config in the operator runbook and timestamp the test alert in a story comment. Closure checks: Heartbeat service name and configuration documented in operator runbook; Test alert triggered and received, timestamped in story comment.
